options: An 8,000 km living barrier of trees, vegetation, and restored land stretching across the entire width of the Sahel from Senegal to Djibouti to combat Sahara desertification
A glass greenhouse in the desert
explanation: The Great Green Wall restores 100 million hectares of degraded Sahelian landscape through community agro-forestry.

subject: GK
chapter: Chapter 12: Global Organizations, Peace, United Nations & Environmental Sustainability
question: Who was the legendary Swedish diplomat and 2nd UN Secretary-General who died in a 1961 plane crash on a Congo peace mission, awarded a posthumous Nobel Peace Prize?
explanation: Dag Hammarskjöld established active UN preventive diplomacy and peacekeeper deployment doctrine.

subject: GK
chapter: Chapter 12: Global Organizations, Peace, United Nations & Environmental Sustainability
question: What is the international environmental treaty known as the 'Basel Convention' (1989)?
options: Controlling and preventing the transboundary movement and dumping of hazardous toxic chemical and electronic waste from developed to developing nations
explanation: The Basel Convention regulates global trade and disposal of hazardous toxic waste and e-scrap.

subject: GK
chapter: Chapter 12: Global Organizations, Peace, United Nations & Environmental Sustainability
question: What is the global initiative known as 'Mission LiFE' (Lifestyle for Environment) launched by India at COP26 and UN in 2022?
options: A mass movement encouraging individual and community behavioral changes to practice mindful, sustainable consumption and circular conservation lifestyles
A mission to send humans to live on Mars
A plan to build electric airplanes
A treaty banning all paper books
explanation: Mission LiFE mobilizes Pro-Planet People (P3) to shift individual consumer behavior towards sustainable ecological practices.

subject: GK
chapter: Chapter 12: Global Organizations, Peace, United Nations & Environmental Sustainability
question: Which Indian woman was the first recipient of the prestigious Ramon Magsaysay Award for Community Leadership (1958) and founded the Bhoodan (Land Gift) Movement?
explanation: Gandhian disciple Acharya Vinoba Bhave won the inaugural 1958 Magsaysay Award for his voluntary Bhoodan land distribution.

subject: GK
chapter: Chapter 12: Global Organizations, Peace, United Nations & Environmental Sustainability
question: What ultimate planetary vision unites the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals and human civilization?
options: Creating an equitable, peaceful, and regenerative world where human dignity, poverty eradication, economic prosperity, and ecological biosphere balance thrive in harmony
Colonizing outer space after destroying Earth
Creating a single world government with no cultural diversity
explanation: The UN SDGs envision a shared global blueprint balancing socio-economic equity with planetary ecological boundaries.

subject: Social Science
chapter: Chapter 12: Buildings, Paintings and Books
question: Where is the famous 1,600-year-old rustless Iron Pillar of King Chandra (Gupta period), which stands 7.2 metres high and weighs over 6 tonnes, located?
options: Mehrauli, New Delhi (in the Qutub Minar complex)
explanation: The Iron Pillar at Mehrauli in Delhi is an enduring metallurgical masterpiece that has withstood corrosion for 16 centuries.

subject: Social Science
chapter: Chapter 12: Buildings, Paintings and Books
question: What does the Sanskrit word 'Stupa' literally mean in Buddhist architecture?
explanation: 'Stupa' translates as mound/tumulus, enshrining sacred bodily relics (dhatu) of the Buddha or his disciples.

subject: Social Science
chapter: Chapter 12: Buildings, Paintings and Books
question: What small container is placed at the very center/heart of a Buddhist stupa containing bodily remains (teeth, bone, ashes) or precious gems of the Buddha?
explanation: The relic casket at the stupa's core preserves sacred osteological relics and inscribed votive gemstones.

subject: Social Science
chapter: Chapter 12: Buildings, Paintings and Books
question: What is the circular path laid around a Buddhist stupa for devotees to perform clockwise walking worship (Pradakshina) called?
explanation: Devotees circumambulate the stupa along the stone-railed Pradakshina patha in a clockwise solar direction.

subject: Social Science
chapter: Chapter 12: Buildings, Paintings and Books
question: Where is the famous 'Great Stupa' built of brick and stone with magnificently carved gateways (Toranas) located?
explanation: The Great Stupa at Sanchi (begun by Ashoka and embellished by the Sungas/Satavahanas) is a UNESCO World Heritage site.

subject: Social Science
chapter: Chapter 12: Buildings, Paintings and Books
question: In ancient Hindu temple architecture, what was the innermost sanctum room where the main image/idol of the presiding deity was installed called?
explanation: The Garbhagriha is the sacred innermost sanctum where the presiding murti resides for ritual worship.

subject: Social Science
chapter: Chapter 12: Buildings, Paintings and Books
question: In ancient Hindu temple architecture, what was the tall rising superstructure tower built over the Garbhagriha to mark it as a sacred mountain peak called?
options: Shikhara (in North Indian Nagara style) / Vimana
explanation: The Shikhara is the towering superstructure rising directly above the garbhagriha, symbolizing Mount Meru.

subject: Social Science
chapter: Chapter 12: Buildings, Paintings and Books
question: In ancient Hindu temple architecture, what was the large assembly hall where devotees gathered to pray and watch sacred dances called?
explanation: The Mandapa is the pillared assembly hall preceding the sanctum for congregational devotion.

subject: Social Science
chapter: Chapter 12: Buildings, Paintings and Books
question: Where are the world-famous rock-cut Buddhist monastery caves decorated with glowing natural mural fresco paintings (painted in torchlight 1500 years ago) located?
explanation: Ajanta's 30 rock-cut caves feature sublime Jataka narrative mural paintings executed under Vakataka patronage.

subject: Social Science
chapter: Chapter 12: Buildings, Paintings and Books
question: Who composed the great Sanskrit epic 'Mahabharata' (which narrates the war between Kauravas and Pandavas and contains the Bhagavad Gita)?
explanation: The epic Mahabharata (comprising 100,000 shlokas) is traditionally attributed to Sage Ved Vyasa.

subject: Social Science
chapter: Chapter 12: Buildings, Paintings and Books
question: Who composed the original Sanskrit epic 'Ramayana', narrating the life and righteous ideals of Prince Rama of Ayodhya?
explanation: Maharishi Valmiki composed the foundational Sanskrit Ramayana in anushtubh verse meter.

subject: Social Science
chapter: Chapter 12: Buildings, Paintings and Books
question: Around 1,900 years ago (c. 105 CE), who invented the manufacturing process of PAPER in China by beating plant fibers, bark, rags, and fishing nets?
explanation: Han dynasty court official Cai Lun synthesized true pulp papermaking in 105 CE, revolutionizing global information transmission.

subject: Social Science
chapter: Chapter 12: Buildings, Paintings and Books
question: What is the famous ancient Tamil epic composed by poet Ilango Adigal around 1800 years ago about the tragic merchant Kovalan, his wife Kannagi, and the court dancer Madhavi?
explanation: Silappadikaram narrates Kannagi's righteous wrath that destroyed Madurai after her husband was unjustly executed for stealing the Queen's anklet.

subject: Social Science
chapter: Chapter 12: Buildings, Paintings and Books
question: What is the famous Tamil sequel epic composed by poet Sattanar around 1400 years ago describing the spiritual adventures of Kovalan and Madhavi's daughter?
explanation: Manimekalai chronicles how Kovalan's daughter renounced worldly riches to become a Buddhist nun dispensing food to the poor with the magic vessel Amritasurabhi.

subject: Social Science
chapter: Chapter 12: Buildings, Paintings and Books
question: What ancient monolithic temple carved entirely out of a SINGLE massive natural granite boulder from top to bottom is found at Mahabalipuram?
explanation: Pallava craftsmen carved the monolithic free-standing Pancha Rathas out of single granite whaleback rocks at Mamallapuram.

subject: Social Science
chapter: Chapter 12: Buildings, Paintings and Books
question: What is the famous early Hindu brick temple dating to around 1500 years ago located in Kanpur district, Uttar Pradesh?
explanation: Bhitargaon is the oldest surviving Gupta-era terraced brick temple with an early curvilinear shikhara and terracotta panels.

subject: Social Science
chapter: Chapter 12: Buildings, Paintings and Books
question: How did artists paint the vivid, luminous mural paintings inside the pitch-dark caves of Ajanta over 1500 years ago?
options: They used natural plant and mineral pigments (clay, ochre, lime, lapis lazuli) applied over a plaster base, illuminated by sunlight reflected from metal mirrors and oil torches
They painted with neon synthetic paints
They painted only during solar eclipses
explanation: Ajanta fresco-secco murals used mineral pigments on clay/lime plaster, illuminated by reflective brass mirrors.

subject: Social Science
chapter: Chapter 12: Buildings, Paintings and Books
question: What famous ancient Indian Sanskrit collection of animal fables with moral and political wisdom was authored by Pandit Vishnu Sharma?
explanation: Vishnu Sharma composed the Panchatantra (Mitra Bheda, Mitra Labha, etc.) to teach statecraft to prince pupils through animal allegories.

subject: Social Science
chapter: Chapter 12: Buildings, Paintings and Books
question: Who was the ancient Indian physician known as the 'Father of Indian Medicine' whose medical treatise 'Charaka Samhita' laid the foundations of Ayurveda?
explanation: Charaka formulated tridosha balance (Vata, Pitta, Kapha), diagnosis, and pharmacology in the foundational 'Charaka Samhita'.

subject: Social Science
chapter: Chapter 12: Buildings, Paintings and Books
question: What scientific explanations did Aryabhata provide in his seminal treatise 'Aryabhatiya' (c. 499 CE)?
options: He explained that day and night are caused by the rotation of the Earth on its axis, provided mathematical rules for calculating solar/lunar eclipses, and calculated π as 3.1416
He claimed Earth was flat and balanced on elephants
He stated the sun orbits the earth every hour
explanation: Aryabhata pioneered heliocentric motion, axial planetary rotation, geometric calculation of eclipses, and trigonometry (jya/sine).

subject: Social Science
chapter: Chapter 12: Buildings, Paintings and Books
question: What are the 'Puranas' in classical Hindu sacred literature?
options: Eighteen major sacred Sanskrit texts containing stories of gods and goddesses (Vishnu, Shiva, Durga), cosmology, genealogies, written in simple verse accessible to all
explanation: The 18 Mahapuranas democratized religious lore: recited aloud in temples so commoners and women could hear sacred wisdom.

subject: Social Science
chapter: Chapter 12: Buildings, Paintings and Books
question: How did the invention and knowledge of Papermaking spread from China across the world?
options: It reached Korea and Japan around 1400 years ago, was transmitted to Baghdad (Arab world) in 751 CE via the Silk Route, and traveled from there to Europe
It was carried by birds flying across oceans
It was discovered independently in every country in the same year
It remained secret in China until 1950
explanation: Following the 751 CE Battle of Talas, Arab artisans learned papermaking in Samarkand/Baghdad, diffusing it to Europe.

subject: Social Science
chapter: Chapter 12: Buildings, Paintings and Books
question: What is the famous sculpture of 'Descent of the Ganga' (Arjuna's Penance) carved on an immense open-air granite rock relief at:
explanation: The 27m × 9m open-air bas-relief at Mahabalipuram depicts Bhagiratha's penance / Arjuna's austerities with celestial nagas and elephants.

subject: Social Science
chapter: Chapter 12: Buildings, Paintings and Books
question: What structural architectural material was used to encase and protect the older Ashokan mud-brick Great Stupa at Sanchi around the 2nd century BCE?
options: A protective outer stone casing, stone harmika balcony, stone railings (vedika), and four elaborately carved Torana gateways
explanation: Sunga and Satavahana patrons doubled Sanchi's diameter with sandstone ashlar casing and sculpted four monumental Torana gateways.

subject: Social Science
chapter: Chapter 12: Buildings, Paintings and Books
question: What famous Buddhist stupa in Andhra Pradesh on the Krishna River was renowned for its exquisite marble-like limestone narrative relief carvings?
explanation: The Maha-chaitya at Amaravati featured dynamic, crowded narrative limestone reliefs depicting the Buddha's life under Satavahana rule.

subject: Social Science
chapter: Chapter 12: Buildings, Paintings and Books
question: Who financed the construction of magnificent stupas, temples, and rock-cut viharas in ancient India?
options: Royal kings, queens, wealthy guild merchants, ivory carvers, farmers, blacksmiths, and humble ordinary lay devotees (recorded in votive inscriptions)
The temples were built by magic without human workers
explanation: Epigraphic donative records prove monument construction was crowdsourced across all social strata: guilds, monks, queens, and artisans.

subject: Social Science
chapter: Chapter 12: Buildings, Paintings and Books
question: What is the famous Gupta-era rock-cut temple carved into the Udayagiri hill caves in Madhya Pradesh known for?
options: The colossal rock-cut bas-relief of Lord Vishnu as Varaha (Boar avatar) rescuing Prithvi (Earth)
The largest Buddha statue in the world
explanation: Udayagiri Cave 5 houses the iconic 5th-century monumental Varaha relief symbolizing geopolitical order restored by the Guptas.

subject: Social Science
chapter: Chapter 12: Buildings, Paintings and Books
question: What ancient Indian treatise on statecraft, economic policy, military strategy, and royal administration was authored by Kautilya (Chanakya)?
explanation: Kautilya's Arthashastra is the premier ancient Sanskrit compendium of political economy, fiscal taxation, and diplomatic espionage.

subject: Social Science
chapter: Chapter 12: Buildings, Paintings and Books
question:
Read the statements:
Assertion (A): The monolithic rock-cut Rathas of Mahabalipuram and the early structural temples of Aihole and Bhitargaon represent the crucible transition from wood/rock caves to permanent stone architecture in India.
Reason (R): Early stone temples directly imitated wooden architectural joinery (beams, rafters, barrel vaults) before developing standardized Nagara and Dravida temple shikhara styles.
Choose the correct option:
options: Both (A) and (R) are true, and (R) is the correct explanation of (A).
Both (A) and (R) are true, but (R) is NOT the correct explanation of (A).
explanation: Petrification of timber architecture is visible in the horseshoe chaitya arches and barrel-vaulted roof forms of Mamallapuram and Aihole.

subject: Social Science
chapter: Chapter 12: Buildings, Paintings and Books
question:
Spot the IMPOSTER in the following group of ancient texts matched with their authors:
Group: [Buddhacharita - Ashvaghosha, Harshacharita - Banabhatta, Aryabhatiya - Aryabhata, Silappadikaram - Sage Valmiki]
explanation: Silappadikaram was composed by the Tamil prince-poet ILANGO ADIGAL, NOT Sage Valmiki (who composed the Sanskrit Ramayana).

subject: Social Science
chapter: Chapter 12: Buildings, Paintings and Books
question:
Consider the architectural components of a classical Hindu Temple:
1. Garbhagriha
2. Shikhara / Vimana
3. Mandapa
4. Pradakshina Patha
What is the spatial and symbolic pathway a devotee follows from entrance to divine communion?
options: Enter through the Mandapa hall -> circumambulate clockwise along the Pradakshina path -> look up at the towering Shikhara -> gaze directly into the Garbhagriha sanctum for Darshan
Start in the Garbhagriha and end at the gate
Climb to the top of the Shikhara first
explanation: The devotee traverses a sacred spatial axis: threshold -> pillared Mandapa -> circumambulation -> sanctum sanctorum (Garbhagriha).

subject: Social Science
chapter: Chapter 12: Buildings, Paintings and Books
question:
Match Column I (Ancient Masterpieces) with Column II (Categories & Authors):
(a) Meghaduta          -> (i) Lyric Sanskrit poem of cloud messenger by Kalidasa
(b) Sushruta Samhita   -> (ii) Foundational surgical medical treatise
(c) Manimekalai        -> (iii) Tamil epic composed by poet Sattanar
(d) Panchatantra       -> (iv) Sanskrit animal fable collection by Vishnu Sharma
explanation: Meghaduta = Kalidasa; Sushruta = surgery; Manimekalai = Sattanar; Panchatantra = Vishnu Sharma.

subject: Social Science
chapter: Chapter 12: Buildings, Paintings and Books
question:
Read the statements regarding ancient Indian literature and art:
Statement 1: Ajanta cave paintings depict scenes from the Jataka tales, illustrating compassion, self-sacrifice, and princely renunciation.
Statement 2: The Bhagavad Gita is an integral part of the Bhishma Parva of the Mahabharata.
Statement 3: Paper was invented in India before it was invented in China.
Which statements are TRUE?
explanation: Statement 3 is false because papermaking was invented in CHINA by Cai Lun in 105 CE (India wrote on palm leaves/birch bark before adopting paper centuries later). Statements 1 and 2 are true.

subject: Social Science
chapter: Chapter 12: Buildings, Paintings and Books
question: What is the profound thematic resolution in the Tamil epic 'Silappadikaram' when Kannagi tears off her left breast and throws it at the city of Madurai?
options: Her cosmic grief and chaste moral power (Karpu) invoke the god of fire to burn corrupt Madurai to ashes, vindicating innocent truth over royal miscarriage of justice
She becomes the new queen of Madurai
She forgives the king with gold
explanation: Kannagi's moral fury incinerates unjust Madurai, deifying her as the supreme goddess of chastity and justice (Pattini).

subject: Social Science
chapter: Chapter 12: Buildings, Paintings and Books
question: Why was birch bark ('Bhurjapatra') and processed palm leaves ('Talapatra') used as the primary writing material in ancient India before the advent of paper?
options: Dried inner bark of Himalayan Betula utilis (birch) and Palmyra palm leaves were cured, trimmed, and inscribed with iron styluses or ink, strung together through central binding holes
Because stone was too light to write on
Because ancient Indians had no metal tools
explanation: Pothi manuscripts utilized inscribed cured palm leaves and birch folios bound with cords through perforations.

subject: Social Science
chapter: Chapter 12: Buildings, Paintings and Books
question: What dramatic story of an artist and king's devotion is represented in the 'Padmapani Bodhisattva' fresco painting in Ajanta Cave 1?
options: The Bodhisattva Avalokiteshvara holding a blue lotus in his hand, radiating infinite serene compassion, graceful tribhanga posture, and sublime spiritual transcendence
A general riding a war horse
explanation: Ajanta's Padmapani Bodhisattva is celebrated globally for its delicate shading, downward compassionate gaze, and spiritual grace.

subject: Social Science
chapter: Chapter 12: Buildings, Paintings and Books
question: How did Aryabhata mathematically calculate the length of the solar year in the 5th century CE?
options: He calculated it as 365.25868 days, remarkably close to modern atomic astronomical calculations (365.25636 days)
He calculated it as exactly 300 days
He stated that days have no fixed length
explanation: Aryabhata determined the sidereal solar year to fractional precision using astronomical epicyclic models.

subject: Social Science
chapter: Chapter 12: Buildings, Paintings and Books
question: What do the diverse architectural forms of Durga Temple at Aihole (with its apsidal curved chaitya-like end) demonstrate about 6th-century Deccan art?
options: It represents a brilliant experimental hybrid where Chalukyan stone masons melded Buddhist rock-cut apsidal plans with emerging Hindu structural temple sanctums
It was built by Roman architects
It was a replica of a Greek stadium
It was carved out of sea ice
explanation: Aihole's Durga temple illustrates architectural experimentation: adapting the apsidal plan of Buddhist chaityas into a Hindu pillared ambulatory temple.

subject: Social Science
chapter: Chapter 12: Buildings, Paintings and Books
question: What is the ancient Sanskrit treatise on dramatic arts, theatre performance, stage aesthetics, and the theory of Nine Rasas (emotions) authored by Sage Bharata?
explanation: Bharata Muni's Natya Shastra formulated classical Indian dramaturgy, abhinaya (acting), and the foundational Rasa aesthetic theory.

subject: Social Science
chapter: Chapter 12: Buildings, Paintings and Books
question: What grand cultural synthesis completes the NCERT Class 6 Social Science History journey in Chapter 12?
options: The realization that ancient Indian civilization bequeathed a glorious heritage of rustless metallurgy, soaring architectural stupas and temples, immortal epic literature, and revolutionary scientific and mathematical breakthroughs that enriched all humankind
A belief that history is only about wars
The conclusion that ancient people knew nothing
A civilization that left no lasting legacy
explanation: The curriculum concludes celebrating ancient India's enduring global legacy across architecture, metallurgy, epic poetry, and mathematics.

subject: Hindi Grammar
chapter: Chapter 12: विराम चिह्न, संधि एवं शब्द संपदा
question: वाक्य को बोलते या लिखते समय भावों को स्पष्ट करने तथा रुकने के लिए जिन विशेष चिह्नों का प्रयोग किया जाता है, उन्हें क्या कहते हैं?
explanation: भाषा में अर्थ की स्पष्टता और भाव प्रकटीकरण हेतु प्रयुक्त ठहराव के संकेत 'विराम चिह्न' कहलाते हैं।

subject: Hindi Grammar
chapter: Chapter 12: विराम चिह्न, संधि एवं शब्द संपदा
question: साधारण वाक्य के पूर्ण समाप्त होने पर अंत में कौन-सा विराम चिह्न लगाया जाता है?
explanation: वाक्य की पूर्ण समाप्ति पर 'पूर्णविराम' (।) लगाया जाता है।

subject: Hindi Grammar
chapter: Chapter 12: विराम चिह्न, संधि एवं शब्द संपदा
question: वाक्य में बहुत थोड़े समय के लिए रुकने या समान पदों को अलग करने के लिए किस चिह्न का प्रयोग होता है?
explanation: अल्पकालिक ठहराव तथा पदों के पृथक्करण हेतु अल्पविराम (,) का प्रयोग होता है।

subject: Hindi Grammar
chapter: Chapter 12: विराम चिह्न, संधि एवं शब्द संपदा
question: हर्ष, शोक, विस्मय, भय, घृणा आदि तीव्र मनोभावों को प्रकट करने वाले शब्दों या वाक्यों के आगे कौन-सा चिह्न लगाया जाता है?
explanation: आश्चर्य, हर्ष, शोक आदि मनोभावों के लिए विस्मयादिबोधक चिह्न (!) प्रयुक्त होता है (जैसे: 'अरे! यह क्या हुआ?')

subject: Hindi Grammar
chapter: Chapter 12: विराम चिह्न, संधि एवं शब्द संपदा
question: दो वर्णों (ध्वनियों) के अत्यंत निकट आने पर उनके परस्पर मेल से होने वाले विकार (परिवर्तन) को क्या कहते हैं?
explanation: दो समीपवर्ती ध्वनियों के मेल से उत्पन्न रूपात्मक परिवर्तन को 'संधि' कहते हैं।

subject: Hindi Grammar
chapter: Chapter 12: विराम चिह्न, संधि एवं शब्द संपदा
question: हिंदी व्याकरण में संधि के मुख्य रूप से कितने भेद होते हैं?
options: तीन भेद (1. स्वर संधि, 2. व्यंजन संधि, 3. विसर्ग संधि)
explanation: संधि के 3 मुख्य भेद हैं: स्वर संधि, व्यंजन संधि, और विसर्ग संधि।

subject: Hindi Grammar
chapter: Chapter 12: विराम चिह्न, संधि एवं शब्द संपदा
question: दो स्वरों के आपस में मिलने से जो विकार या परिवर्तन होता है (जैसे: 'विद्या + आलय = विद्यालय'), उसे क्या कहते हैं?
explanation: स्वर वर्ण के साथ स्वर वर्ण के मेल से होने वाला विकार 'स्वर संधि' कहलाता है।

subject: Hindi Grammar
chapter: Chapter 12: विराम चिह्न, संधि एवं शब्द संपदा
question: स्वर संधि के मुख्य कितने भेद होते हैं?
options: पाँच भेद (दीर्घ, गुण, वृद्धि, यण, और अयादि संधि)
explanation: स्वर संधि के 5 भेद हैं: 1. दीर्घ, 2. गुण, 3. वृद्धि, 4. यण, तथा 5. अयादि संधि।

subject: Hindi Grammar
chapter: Chapter 12: विराम चिह्न, संधि एवं शब्द संपदा
question: 'सूर्य + उदय' का सही संधि युक्त शब्द क्या होगा?
options: सूर्योदय (गुण स्वर संधि : अ + उ = ओ)
explanation: सूर्य (अ) + उदय (उ) = सूर्योदय (गुण संधि: अ + उ = ओ)।

subject: Hindi Grammar
chapter: Chapter 12: विराम चिह्न, संधि एवं शब्द संपदा
question: समान अर्थ प्रकट करने वाले पर्यायवाची शब्दों में 'कमल' के सही पर्यायवाची शब्दों का समूह कौन-सा है?
options: जलज, पंकज, नीरज, सरोज, राजीव, अरविंद
explanation: कमल के पर्यायवाची: जलज, पंकज, नीरज, सरोज, राजीव, अरविंद, पद्म।

subject: Hindi Grammar
chapter: Chapter 12: विराम चिह्न, संधि एवं शब्द संपदा
question:
विलोम (विपरीतार्थक) शब्दों के सही युग्म की पहचान कीजिए:
'अमृत' का विलोम शब्द क्या है?
explanation: अमृत का विपरीतार्थक (विलोम) शब्द 'विष' या 'गरल' होता है।

subject: Hindi Grammar
chapter: Chapter 12: विराम चिह्न, संधि एवं शब्द संपदा
question:
वाक्यांश के लिए एक शब्द बताइए:
'जो सब कुछ जानता हो' को क्या कहते हैं?
explanation: सब कुछ जानने वाला = 'सर्वज्ञ'; कम जानने वाला = 'अल्पज्ञ'; जो कुछ न जानता हो = 'अज्ञ'।

subject: Hindi Grammar
chapter: Chapter 12: विराम चिह्न, संधि एवं शब्द संपदा
question: किसी के कहे हुए कथन को ज्यों-का-त्यों उद्धृत करने के लिए किस चिह्न का प्रयोग किया जाता है?
options: उद्धरण चिह्न / अवतरण चिह्न (दोहरा उद्धरण " " या इकहरा उद्धरण ' ')
explanation: वक्ता के मूल कथन को सुरक्षित रखने हेतु दोहरा उद्धरण चिह्न (" ") प्रयुक्त होता है।

subject: Hindi Grammar
chapter: Chapter 12: विराम चिह्न, संधि एवं शब्द संपदा
question: शब्दों के संक्षिप्त रूप (abbreviation) को लिखने के लिए (जैसे: 'डॉक्टर' के लिए 'डॉ०', 'पंडित' के लिए 'पं०') किस चिह्न का प्रयोग होता है?
explanation: संक्षिप्त रूप दर्शाने हेतु प्रयुक्त लघु शून्यवत प्रतीक 'लाघव चिह्न' (०) कहलाता है।

subject: Hindi Grammar
chapter: Chapter 12: विराम चिह्न, संधि एवं शब्द संपदा
question: लिखते समय जब कोई शब्द या अंश छूट जाता है, तो उसे ऊपर लिखने के लिए किस चिह्न का प्रयोग किया जाता है?
explanation: छूटे हुए शब्द को सम्मिलित करने हेतु 'त्रुटिपूरक / हंसपद चिह्न' (^) लगाया जाता है।

subject: Hindi Grammar
chapter: Chapter 12: विराम चिह्न, संधि एवं शब्द संपदा
question: 'देव + इंद्र = देवेंद्र' और 'महा + ईश = महेश' में कौन-सी स्वर संधि है?
explanation: अ/आ के साथ इ/ई के मेल से 'ए' विकार उत्पन्न होना 'गुण स्वर संधि' का नियम है।

subject: Hindi Grammar
chapter: Chapter 12: विराम चिह्न, संधि एवं शब्द संपदा
question: 'सदा + एव = सदैव' और 'एक + एक = एकैक' में कौन-सी स्वर संधि है?
explanation: अ/आ के आगे ए/ऐ आने पर 'ऐ' हो जाना 'वृद्धि स्वर संधि' है (सदा + एव = सदैव)।

subject: Hindi Grammar
chapter: Chapter 12: विराम चिह्न, संधि एवं शब्द संपदा
question: 'यदि + अपि = यद्यपि' और 'इति + आदि = इत्यादि' में कौन-सी स्वर संधि है?
options: यण स्वर संधि (इ/ई + असमान स्वर = य्)
explanation: इ/ई का 'य्' में परिवर्तन 'यण स्वर संधि' कहलाता है (यदि + अपि = यद्यपि)।

subject: Hindi Grammar
chapter: Chapter 12: विराम चिह्न, संधि एवं शब्द संपदा
question: 'ने + अन = नयन' और 'पौ + अक = पावक' में कौन-सी स्वर संधि है?
options: अयादि स्वर संधि (ए का अय्, ओ का अव्, औ का आव्)
explanation: ए/ऐ/ओ/औ के आगे स्वर आने पर अय्/आय्/अव्/आव् में रूपांतरण 'अयादि स्वर संधि' कहलाता है।

subject: Hindi Grammar
chapter: Chapter 12: विराम चिह्न, संधि एवं शब्द संपदा
question: अनेकार्थी शब्द 'कर' के विभिन्न अर्थों का सही समूह कौन-सा है?
options: हाथ, टैक्स (लगान), किरण, और हाथी की सूँड़
explanation: 'कर' के अनेकार्थ हैं: हाथ (हस्त), टैक्स/शुल्क, सूर्य की किरण, तथा सूँड़।

subject: Hindi Grammar
chapter: Chapter 12: विराम चिह्न, संधि एवं शब्द संपदा
question: अनेकार्थी शब्द 'अंबर' के दो मुख्य अर्थ क्या हैं?
explanation: 'अंबर' के दो प्रमुख अर्थ हैं: आकाश/नभ तथा वस्त्र/चीर (जैसे: पीतांबर = पीला वस्त्र)।

subject: Hindi Grammar
chapter: Chapter 12: विराम चिह्न, संधि एवं शब्द संपदा
question: श्रुतिसम भिन्नार्थक शब्द 'अनल' और 'अनिल' के सही अर्थ क्रमशः क्या हैं?
explanation: 'अनल' का अर्थ आग है और 'अनिल' का अर्थ वायु/समीर है।

subject: Hindi Grammar
chapter: Chapter 12: विराम चिह्न, संधि एवं शब्द संपदा
question: श्रुतिसम भिन्नार्थक शब्द 'कुल' और 'कूल' के सही अर्थ क्रमशः क्या हैं?
explanation: 'कुल' (ह्रस्व उ) = वंश/समग्र; 'कूल' (दीर्घ ऊ) = नदी का किनारा/तट।

subject: Hindi Grammar
chapter: Chapter 12: विराम चिह्न, संधि एवं शब्द संपदा
question:
वाक्यांश के लिए एक शब्द बताइए:
'जिसका कोई शत्रु न जन्मा हो' को क्या कहते हैं?
explanation: जिसका कोई शत्रु न उत्पन्न हुआ हो = 'अजातशत्रु'; जिसे जीता न जा सके = 'अजेय'।

subject: Hindi Grammar
chapter: Chapter 12: विराम चिह्न, संधि एवं शब्द संपदा
question:
वाक्यांश के लिए एक शब्द बताइए:
'जो आँखों के सामने हो' और 'जो आँखों के सामने न हो' के लिए सही शब्द क्या हैं?
explanation: नेत्रों के सम्मुख = 'प्रत्यक्ष'; नेत्रों से परे = 'परोक्ष'।

subject: Hindi Grammar
chapter: Chapter 12: विराम चिह्न, संधि एवं शब्द संपदा
question: विलोम शब्दों के सही समूह की पहचान कीजिए:
options: अनुराग : विराग, उदय : अस्त, उत्थान : पतन, स्वाधीन : पराधीन, प्रत्यक्ष : परोक्ष
सत्य : सच, रात : निशा, जल : नीर
explanation: अनुराग-विराग, उदय-अस्त, उत्थान-पतन, स्वाधीन-पराधीन प्रामाणिक विलोम युग्म हैं।

subject: Hindi Grammar
chapter: Chapter 12: विराम चिह्न, संधि एवं शब्द संपदा
question: पर्यायवाची शब्दों में 'बादल' के सही पर्यायवाची शब्दों का समूह कौन-सा है?
options: मेघ, घन, जलद, वारिद, नीरद, पयोधर
explanation: जल देने वाले (द = देने वाला): जलद, वारिद, नीरद, मेघ, घन = बादल।

subject: Hindi Grammar
chapter: Chapter 12: विराम चिह्न, संधि एवं शब्द संपदा
question:
वाक्य में विराम चिह्नों का सही प्रयोग पहचानिए:
'सुभाष चंद्र बोस ने कहा था तुम मुझे खून दो मैं तुम्हें आज़ादी दूँगा'
options: सुभाष चंद्र बोस ने कहा था, "तुम मुझे खून दो, मैं तुम्हें आज़ादी दूँगा!"
सुभाष चंद्र बोस ने कहा था तुम मुझे खून दो मैं तुम्हें आज़ादी दूँगा।
"सुभाष चंद्र बोस ने कहा था" तुम मुझे खून दो मैं तुम्हें आज़ादी दूँगा?
सुभाष चंद्र बोस ने कहा था: तुम मुझे खून दो मैं तुम्हें आज़ादी दूँगा।
explanation: वक्ता के उपरांत अल्पविराम तथा ऐतिहासिक नारे को दोहरा उद्धरण चिह्न ("...") में विस्मयादिबोधक के साथ लिखना शुद्ध है।

subject: Hindi Grammar
chapter: Chapter 12: विराम चिह्न, संधि एवं शब्द संपदा
question:
कथन और कारण को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़ें:
कथन (A): 'रोको मत जाने दो' वाक्य में यदि 'रोको' के बाद अल्पविराम लगाया जाए ('रोको, मत जाने दो'), तो अर्थ होता है रोकना ; किन्तु यदि 'मत' के बाद अल्पविराम लगाया जाए ('रोको मत, जाने दो'), तो अर्थ ठीक उल्टा होकर जाने देना हो जाता है।
कारण (R): विराम चिह्नों का स्थान परिवर्तन वाक्य के पूरे भाव और अर्थ को पूर्णतया बदल देता है।
सही विकल्प चुनें:
options: (A) और (R) दोनों सही हैं तथा (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।
(A) और (R) दोनों सही हैं, परन्तु (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता।
explanation: अल्पविराम का स्थान परिवर्तन वाक्य के अर्थ में 180-डिग्री का विपर्यास उत्पन्न कर देता है।

subject: Hindi Grammar
chapter: Chapter 12: विराम चिह्न, संधि एवं शब्द संपदा
question:
Spot the IMPOSTER in the following group of संधि विच्छेद और उनके प्रकारों में:
Group: [हिम + आलय = हिमालय (दीर्घ संधि), नर + ईश = नरेश (गुण संधि), महा + ऐश्वर्य = महैश्वर्य (वृद्धि संधि), सु + आगत = स्वागत (अयादि संधि)]
explanation: 'सु + आगत = स्वागत' यण स्वर संधि (उ का व्) है, अयादि संधि नहीं।

subject: Hindi Grammar
chapter: Chapter 12: विराम चिह्न, संधि एवं शब्द संपदा
question:
सुमेलित कीजिए (विराम चिह्न और उनके मानक प्रतीक):
(क) अर्धविराम     -> (i) ?
(ख) अल्पविराम     -> (ii) ;
(ग) विस्मयादिबोधक -> (iii) ,
(घ) प्रश्नवाचक     -> (iv) !
explanation: अर्धविराम = ; ; अल्पविराम = , ; विस्मयादिबोधक = ! ; प्रश्नवाचक = ?।

subject: Hindi Grammar
chapter: Chapter 12: विराम चिह्न, संधि एवं शब्द संपदा
question: 'पो + अन = पवन' और 'पौ + अन = पावन' में संधि नियमों का सूक्ष्म अंतर क्या है?
options: 'पो' (ओ) + अन में 'ओ' का 'अव्' होकर 'पवन' बनता है ; जबकि 'पौ' (औ) + अन में 'औ' का 'आव्' होकर 'पावन' बनता है (अयादि संधि)
दोनों में कोई नियम नहीं है
explanation: अयादि संधि नियम: ओ + अन = अव् (पवन); औ + अन = आव् (पावन)।

subject: Hindi Grammar
chapter: Chapter 12: विराम चिह्न, संधि एवं शब्द संपदा
question: संधि और समास में क्या तात्विक (मूलभूत) अंतर होता है?
options: संधि दो वर्णों/ध्वनियों का मेल होती है जिससे ध्वनि विकार होता है (जैसे: 'विद्या + आलय = विद्यालय') ; जबकि समास दो या दो से अधिक सार्थक पदों/शब्दों का मेल होता है जिसमें कारक चिह्न लुप्त होते हैं (जैसे: 'राजा का पुत्र = राजपुत्र')
संधि केवल संस्कृत में होती है
समास केवल दो शब्दों में होता है
दोनों में कोई अंतर नहीं है
explanation: संधि = वर्णों/ध्वनियों का विकारमूलक संयोग; समास = पदों/शब्दों का विभक्तिरहित संक्षिप्तीकरण।

subject: Hindi Grammar
chapter: Chapter 12: विराम चिह्न, संधि एवं शब्द संपदा
question: अनेकार्थी शब्द 'द्विज' के विभिन्न अर्थों का सही समूह कौन-सा है?
options: ब्राह्मण, पक्षी, दाँत, और चंद्रमा (जिनका दो बार जन्म माना जाता है)
explanation: द्वि (दो) + ज (जन्मा): ब्राह्मण (उपनयन से द्वितीय जन्म), पक्षी (अंडे से जन्म), दाँत (दूध के दाँत के बाद पुनर्जन्म), चंद्रमा।

subject: Hindi Grammar
chapter: Chapter 12: विराम चिह्न, संधि एवं शब्द संपदा
question: श्रुतिसम भिन्नार्थक शब्द 'अलि' और 'अली' के सही अर्थ क्रमशः क्या हैं?
explanation: 'अलि' (ह्रस्व इ) = भ्रमर/भौंरा; 'अली' (दीर्घ ई) = सखी/सहेली।

subject: Hindi Grammar
chapter: Chapter 12: विराम चिह्न, संधि एवं शब्द संपदा
question: 'पितृ + आज्ञा' और 'मातृ + उपदेश' का शुद्ध संधि रूप क्रमशः क्या होगा?
options: पित्राज्ञा और मात्रुपदेश (यण स्वर संधि : ऋ + असमान स्वर = र्)
explanation: ऋ + आ = रा (पित्राज्ञा); ऋ + उ = रु (मात्रुपदेश) - यण संधि।

subject: Hindi Grammar
chapter: Chapter 12: विराम चिह्न, संधि एवं शब्द संपदा
question:
वाक्यांश के लिए एक शब्द का सही सुमेल बताइए:
(क) उपकार को मानने वाला -> कृतज्ञ
(ख) उपकार को न मानने वाला -> कृतघ्न
(ग) जो गिना न जा सके -> अगणित (असंख्येय)
(घ) जो सबमें व्याप्त हो -> सर्वव्यापी
उपर्युक्त में से कौन-से सुमेल सही हैं?
options: सभी (क, ख, ग, घ) पूर्णतः सत्य हैं
explanation: कृतज्ञ (उपकार मानने वाला), कृतघ्न (अकृतज्ञ/न मानने वाला), अगणित, सर्वव्यापी - चारों प्रामाणिक हैं।

subject: Hindi Grammar
chapter: Chapter 12: विराम चिह्न, संधि एवं शब्द संपदा
question: योजक चिह्न (-) का प्रयोग किन-किन परिस्थितियों में अनिवार्य रूप से किया जाता है?
options: द्वंद्व समास के पदों के बीच (माता-पिता), पुनरुक्त शब्दों के बीच (धीरे-धीरे), तुलनात्मक 'सा/सी/से' से पूर्व (चाँद-सा मुखड़ा), और विलोम युग्मों के बीच (दिन-रात)
केवल संज्ञा और क्रिया के बीच
explanation: योजक चिह्न (-) द्वंद्व युग्मों, पुनरुक्ति, विलोमों तथा 'सा/सी' सादृश्यवाचियों में प्रयुक्त होता है।

subject: Hindi Grammar
chapter: Chapter 12: विराम चिह्न, संधि एवं शब्द संपदा
question: हिंदी भाषा की समृद्धि में 'शब्द संपदा' (Vocabulary Enrichment) का क्या सर्वोच्च महत्व है?
options: सटीक, समृद्ध शब्द संपदा से विचार-अभिव्यक्ति अत्यंत सजीव, प्रभावशाली, लालित्यपूर्ण तथा अर्थ-गांभीर्य से परिपूर्ण बनती है
शब्द संपदा से केवल शब्दकोश भारी होता है
ज्यादा शब्दों से भाषा कठिन हो जाती है
शब्द संपदा का कोई विशेष लाभ नहीं है
explanation: शब्द संपदा भाषा की सूक्ष्म अभिव्यंजना शक्ति, संप्रेषणीयता और वैचारिक प्रखरता का मूल आधार है।

subject: Hindi Grammar
chapter: Chapter 12: विराम चिह्न, संधि एवं शब्द संपदा
question: कक्षा 6 के संपूर्ण हिंदी व्याकरण पाठ्यक्रम का चरम उद्देश्य क्या है?
options: छात्रों में मानक भाषा की शुद्ध वर्तनी, व्याकरणिक नियमों की गहरी समझ, समृद्ध संप्रेषण कौशल तथा रचनात्मक चिंतन का सर्वांगीण विकास करना
explanation: पाठ्यक्रम का लक्ष्य शुद्ध मानक भाषा ज्ञान, तार्किक व्याकरणिक दक्षता, और रचनात्मक अभिव्यक्ति का समग्र परिष्कार है।
